panel_description_zh: 中景平视，妻子坐在沙发上伸出一只手（示意倒水）；表情不耐烦（眼瞟别处、眉中拱、嘴微张）；李斌在画面外。
prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot of a 30-something East Asian Chinese woman sitting on the grey fabric sofa, one hand casually extended outward at hip height with palm up indicating '李斌，给我倒杯水。'. Impatient done-with-this expression — eyes looking toward the TV or the phone (not at the husband off-frame in the bedroom), eyebrows slightly raised in the middle in a done-with-this arch, mouth slightly open with exhaled breath. Long straight black hair completely down, single pearl stud earring, small gold locket at neckline. Fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top, light grey high-waisted yoga leggings, fluffy-cuff light grey memory-foam house slippers, fresh nude-pink gel manicure visible on the extended hand. Warm yellow-white living room light plus cool TV backlight. Mood: the first summon of the chain, casual but pointed. Text watermark 'P14-PN03' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, full frontal face shot, smiling, husband visible in the frame, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, bloodshot eyes, romantic soft lighting, dramatic shadows
